namespace: Array and ListWithDetail Control item-label data path
default: first primitive item property when available, otherwise a localized Item {index} label
effect: reads an item-relative data path for each collection item's visible label, using translated enum/oneOf choice labels when available without changing item data or identity
precedence: selected Control local elementLabelProp precedes the generated fallback; removed global elementLabelProp and unsupported childLabelProp are ignored
